review_candidates.description: Systems Engineer – MoD / Defence Systems Location: Redhill, Surrey Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time Industry: Defence, Government & Satellite Communications The Opportunity: We are working with a leading international provider of secure communications, satellite communications and systems integration solutions to recruit a Systems Engineer specialising in MoD and Government systems . The organisation supports defence, government and other mission-critical customers with highly secure communications and network infrastructure. This is a hands-on engineering position involving the design, configuration, testing and delivery of systems for UK MoD and Government projects . Due to the nature of the customers and projects involved, there are specific nationality, residency and security clearance requirements for this position. Working Arrangements: The role is based in Redhill, Surrey . Candidates must be able to work onsite in Redhill for the first 6 months . Following the initial 6-month period, there is flexibility for up to 6 remote working days per month . Candidates must therefore live within a commutable distance of Redhill or be prepared to relocate. Customer-site travel may occasionally be required. Security & Eligibility Requirements: Due to the sensitive nature of the defence and government projects involved: Candidates must be a national of a NATO member country . Candidates must have been resident in the UK for the last 5 years . Candidates must hold, or be capable of achieving, UK DV Security Clearance . Candidates must be comfortable working within secure MoD/Government environments and complying with the associated security procedures. Key Responsibilities: Design and configure systems for MoD and Government projects . Deliver assigned engineering projects in accordance with project specifications. Liaise with the Projects Office to ensure successful delivery of assigned work. Interpret customer and project requirements and translate them into practical system designs. Define IP structures for new projects. Define equipment lists and technical specifications. Provide technical guidance to engineering and project teams. Produce and maintain drawings and technical documentation. Verify technical equipment against project specifications. Test and evaluate new equipment. Verify new software builds against agreed test criteria and performance requirements. Support customer meetings relating to future projects, system enhancements and technical requirements. Visit customer sites where required to support project delivery. Provide technical information in support of new proposals. Support trials and liaise with MoD/Government agencies where required. Provide training on newly introduced systems. Participate proactively in the MoD/Government engineering support structure and rota. Take ownership of assigned work and deliver projects with limited supervision. Essential Experience & Skills: Previous experience working within UK MoD, defence or closely related secure Government environments . Strong systems engineering and/or communications engineering experience. Good understanding of IP networks and network design . Hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies at approximately CCNA level or above , or equivalent practical experience. Alternatively, comparable Juniper networking experience . Experience interpreting technical/project requirements and delivering systems against specifications. Experience producing and working with technical documentation. Ability to test, verify and troubleshoot technical equipment and systems. Strong problem-solving and engineering judgement. Ability to take ownership of technical work with minimal supervision. Excellent communication and time-management skills. Comfortable liaising with customers, internal stakeholders and Government/Defence organisations. Flexible and proactive approach. Highly Desirable: Broad ICT engineering experience. Satellite communications / SatCom experience. Secure communications experience. Defence network design experience. Experience with military communications infrastructure. Experience defining IP structures and equipment specifications. Systems integration experience. Project engineering experience. Existing or previous UK security clearance. Professional engineering registration. Qualifications: Degree-level qualification in Engineering, Telecommunications, IT or another relevant discipline; or Relevant professional experience at an equivalent level. An Engineering degree would be advantageous. Cisco CCNA or equivalent practical experience, or comparable Juniper experience. What Will Make You Stand Out? We are particularly interested in engineers who combine hands-on networking and systems engineering expertise with genuine MoD/Defence experience. You may currently be working as a: Defence Systems Engineer MoD Systems Engineer Communications Systems Engineer Defence Network Engineer Secure Communications Engineer Military Communications Engineer SatCom Engineer Systems Integration Engineer Defence Project Engineer Military leavers with strong communications, networking or systems engineering experience are also encouraged to apply where they meet the technical and security requirements. Why Apply? Work directly on technically challenging MoD and Government systems projects . Exposure to secure communications, networking and satellite technologies. Work across the full engineering lifecycle from requirements and design through testing and delivery. Join an established engineering organisation operating within the defence and secure communications sector. Long-term technical and career development opportunities. Hybrid flexibility following the initial onsite period. Important: Please only apply if you can meet the security and working-location requirements. You must be able to work onsite in Redhill for the first 6 months. Following this period, the role offers up to 6 remote working days per month. Due to the nature of the organisation's defence and government customers, candidates must be nationals of a NATO member country, have been resident in the UK for the last 5 years, and be capable of achieving the required UK security clearance. Contact: Elvis Eckardt

review_candidates.description: Functie WAT MAG JE VERWACHTEN? Als Microsoft Infrastructure Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie en service van ICT infrastructuur bij onze B2B- klanten. Zowel de dagdagelijkse opvolging, onderhoud en veranderings- en vernieuwingsprojecten vallen hieronder. Met behulp van jouw expertise, ondersteun je de klant op vlak van Microsoft oplossingen (Windows Operating System, Active Directory, GPO, …) en Cloud Services zoals Azure en Microsoft 365. Je hebt veel kennis over het opzetten van infrastructuur voor Modern IT (MDM, EMS, MAM). Vragen van onze klanten met betrekking tot Client Windows, Client deployment behoren tot jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Kennis van System Center is een meerwaarde. Je neemt klantendossiers ter harte, denkt mee met de klant en optimaliseert zijn ICT park. Je staat in voor de volledige documentatie van je geleverde werk. Bij de oplevering van projecten werk je samen met de Project Manager. Je Skills WAT VRAGEN WE VAN JOU? Je kan terugblikken op minimum drie jaar relevante ervaring in een gelijkaardige job als System Engineer. Met je passie voor IT en kennis in Microsoft-oplossingen ben je in staat om de klant zijn proces te optimaliseren. Je bent reeds vertrouwd bent met Microsoft Cloud services (Microsoft 365, office 365, EMS, Intune). Daarnaast kan je enige ervaring aantonen met System Center, OS Deployment en Client Management. Met behulp van je verantwoordelijkheidszin, stressbestendigheid en klantgerichtheid slaag jij erin om klanten succesvol verder te helpen. Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands en Engels. Troeven WAT KRIJG JE VAN ONS? Bij VanRoey bieden we medewerkers kansen in een inspirerende werkomgeving. We zijn trots om al 4x op toe gecertificeerd te zijn als Great Place to Work, waar groei en plezier hand in hand gaan. Kies je voor een job als Modern Workplace Engineer dan bieden we jou: Persoonlijke & Technische Groei: Toegang tot trainingen, workshops en certificeringen. Werkplezier: Een inspirerende werkomgeving met ruimte voor fun en gezelligheid! Balans: Flexibele werkuren, telewerk en 12 adv-dagen. Beloning: Een competitief loonpakket met extralegale voordelen zoals een bedrijfswagen, gsm-abonnement, laptop en meer. Lekker eten: In ons eigen Roeftop Restaurant!
